Humans enter the world, said to have been born of the heart of [[Shao Daraan]] himself and destined to inherit the world, they came down from the blade peaks and established villages on the north and south of the mountain range. They are a primitive society for a number of years but despite their short lifespans they advance to the medieval level within a thousand years, indicating their aptitude for learning and ability to adapt.
